tasks.summary: Added `subtitles.postman_collection.json` scenarios for anonymous and authenticated free playback, entitled and denied paid playback, Korean/English, English-only and empty subtitles, hidden/future episodes and dramas, and malformed JWTs. Success checks verify response keys, subtitle item keys, language ordering, formats, HTTPS URLs, and one-hour expiry; denials check that media URLs are absent. Updated suite selection to expect twelve suites and verify the subtitles suite is deduplicated and uses the exclusive lock. C1/C5 review: the collection consumes the fixture environment keys and checks approved response behavior. Both declared checks passed: Postman JSON and event-script syntax validation; suiteSelection tests (23 passed). HTTP execution is deferred to task-4 after API implementation.
